meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage channel integration via Chat SDK. Local (macOS) or remote (Photon API) mode.

copy.tagline: 集成 iMessage 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 iMessage 发送功能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add iMessage sending to your app.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 iMessage 收发消息，支持本地 Mac 或远程 Photon 服务器两种模式。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 iMessage 频道，或进行 /setup 流程时触发。需要先选择模式（本地或远程）并完成相应配置。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 频道，使用本地模式。
say.note: Claude 会开始配置本地 iMessage 适配器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive iMessages, supporting local (macOS) or remote (Photon API) mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add an iMessage channel or during the /setup flow. Requires selecting a mode (local or remote) and completing the corresponding setup.

say_en.text: Add iMessage channel using local mode.
say_en.note: Claude will start configuring the local iMessage adapter.

say_en.text: Set up remote iMessage, my Photon server URL is https://photon.example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the API key and complete remote setup.
